messages.author: 5a75034e9d3f4f59
messages.subject: Ploting with date and time
parts:
Hi Everyone, 

I am trying plot a line graph of two different temperatures with date & time on the x-axis and I never be able to put it work. 

Is there a way I can plot it with smooth line graph? I want one graph per Site. 

Thank you!

Thort

messages.author: 108965c4995434a3
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Ploting with date and time
parts:
I think your issues is the length, of the data points, which are different for different sites. One easiest way to solve this problem:
1> make a date vector from 05/06/2018 2:00 to 05/16/2018 8:00
2> make vectors for A and B with same size of the date vector, note that the vectors using matrix command have NAN elements
3> define data.frame with X = Date, Y1 = vector A and Y2 = vector B.
4>then use ggplot as usual with Xlimits =c( 05/06/2018 2:00, 05/16/2018 8:00 )
Even you use same length of different plot, do as usual using new data frame.

I hope you can do now.

Good luck

M

  select(Site, Ap_Prac, N0, Date_Time, H2O_Tem_Inside, H2O_Tem_Outside)%>%
  gather(key = Prob_placement, value = 'Temperature', `H2O_Tem_Inside` : `H2O_Tem_Outside`) # Put data into lengthen format,

ggplot(data =NH3_Temperature%>%filter(Site == "A"), aes(x= Date_Time, y = Temperature), color = Prob_placement ) +

  scale_x_datetime(breaks = date_breaks ("day"))

Thort

messages.subject: Re: Ploting with date and time
parts:
I did something similar this way- attached is also my figure...

mass$date<-as.Date(mass$date) #  change the date column to as.date


massdate <- ggplot(data = mass1,aes(x=date, y=massnit,color=as.factor(site))) +
  geom_point(size=4) +geom_line()+
  xlab("date") + ylab("mass kgNO3-N/ha") +# ylim(300, 0)+
  labs(color='Site') +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months" , date_labels = "%b")+  #the green is the date format
  my_theme
massdate+facet_wrap(~depth,ncol=1) #the blue can work as your site
